tools.name: get_hosting_plans
tools.description: Get current public plans, hardware limits, locations, prices and stock for game, cloud (VDS), or bot hosting. Prices are integers in minor currency units: 22900 means 229.00 RUB. Data is cached server-side for up to one hour.

tools.name: get_wiki_article
tools.description: Read a complete wiki article as Markdown, including links to related articles. Article content is in Russian. Does not navigate the current tab.

tools.name: list_site_pages
tools.description: Discover Bisquit hosting, app download and developer pages. Returns paths, descriptions and URLs in the current locale. For documentation, use list_wiki_articles.

tools.name: list_wiki_articles
tools.description: List all Bisquit wiki articles with slugs, titles, sections and URLs. Use this to browse documentation topics before reading an article.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Open a public Bisquit page or wiki article in the current browser tab, preserving the current locale. Use a path from list_site_pages or /wiki/<slug> from wiki results. This changes the visible page.

path.description: Local page path, such as /game or /wiki/services/faq. No external URLs.

tools.name: read_site_page
tools.description: Read a public site page as Markdown without navigating. For live prices use get_hosting_plans; for wiki content use get_wiki_article. Page summaries are in English.

tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Search Bisquit documentation in Russian or English. Returns matching article slugs, links and excerpts. Read a match with get_wiki_article.

query.description: Search words, such as backups or установка плагинов.
